subject.title: perf(gateway): fold session touched-files incrementally via transcript delta

question: Should this protected gateway performance change land after the author supplies an after-fix real-session trace covering the cached, append, and reset paths?
rationale: The code path changes how a user-visible session-derived result is maintained in memory, and the available evidence establishes pre-fix production cost plus mock tests but not the claimed after-fix runtime outcome.

options.title: Request real-session proof
options.body: Require redacted after-fix terminal output or runtime logs that compare a long session’s file-list result and latency across initial, appended, and reset reads.

options.title: Accept existing evidence
options.body: Land based on the focused regressions and existing production diagnosis while accepting that the reported performance result is not independently shown after the patch.

recommendation.title: Request real-session proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted after-fix terminal output or runtime logs that compare a long session’s file-list result and latency across initial, appended, and reset reads.
